usage: The word 皮革 (pei4 gaak3) is used to refer to leather as a material.
It can be used to describe products made from animal skin that has been treated and tanned.
When talking about fashion or upholstery, 皮革 is the common term for leather.
The word is a noun and usually functions as the subject or object in a sentence.
It's often combined with other words to specify the type or item made of leather.
